name: Hybrid Volume-based Densification
aliases: Point Densitification based on Hybrid Volume
definition: A densification strategy that uses a grid-based volumetric representation to supply missing Gaussian points in low-texture, distant, or sky regions where SfM initialization fails, preventing empty 2D splats.
summary: Hybrid Volume-based Densification uses a neural radiance field to predict density and position, adding Gaussian splats to fill voids where Structure-from-Motion fails.
